adf.action: ADF rejects a unit root at the level (p=0.0000), so d=0. The ACF still shows a dominant 52-week cycle that a unit-root test is blind to, so one seasonal difference (D=1, m=52) is applied; the differenced series is also stationary.

E1_multi_lag_exog.desc: SARIMAX with lags 1, 2 and 52 of humidity, temperature and cloud (9 regressors)

E2_log_sarimax.desc: SARIMAX fitted on log(solar) and back-transformed

E3_ensemble_mean.desc: Equal-weight average of the SARIMA and SARIMAX one-step forecasts
